Trigeminal Neuralgia: No abnormalities on contrast-enhanced MRI of the head, which might be expected to show some abnormality in classic trigeminal neuralgia, although not always
Pain localization: V2 and V3 distributions of the left trigeminal nerve
Pain triggers: jaw movement during eating or tooth brushing
Allodynia to cold air and hypersensitivity to touch in the affected area
Distorted sensations in the V2 region during attacks
